components.title: AirPlay network test service
components.description: For the app AirPlay Test: the network test (a test AirPlay receiver announced over mDNS) and, stage 1 of an AirPlay receiver, UxPlay's protocol on the head unit, which counts the mirrored picture it gets (nothing shown yet). Opens the firewall for its ports only while a test runs.
components.author: aurelmarius

components.title: AirPlay Test
components.description: AirPlay receiver for the head unit, in stages: the network test (can an iPhone find and reach the head unit?) and stage 1, UxPlay's protocol counting the mirrored picture during CarPlay. Needs the AirPlay test service.

components.title: Wheel Heating
components.description: Steering wheel heating on/off from a favourite button: for a heated iDrive 8 (LCI) steering wheel without its own button, fitted to an iDrive 7 car
